pictures.prompt: The inside of a grand royal castle great hall seen straight on from the middle of the room, tall stone arches and pillars on both sides, huge stained-glass windows glowing gold and blue, red and gold banners hanging from the walls, flickering torches and candle chandeliers, a polished stone floor stretching back to a big throne on a raised step far away in the distance, warm golden light pouring down the centre, soft floating dust motes, the middle of the picture open and calm, wide landscape.
